Run +natural=1 +natural-first=v +natural-bytes=2048 +natural-trace=/tmp/trace.csv +pause-mode=1 +pause-offers=4 +pause-window=10000; expect PASS and full byte copy. PAUSE42-JSON request, sealed (if held drops), first_quiet (if reached), end, terminal lines emitted with valid JSON. 3. Run same with +pause-mode=2; expect PASS only if A quiet occurs during pause while A job not done, and no new source child admissions after quiet until resume. 4. assumptions: 1. The target file out/committed-write-drain-20261008/multi_test.cpp is an exact copy of the supplied out/prepared-source-bypass-20261008/multi_test.cpp at the time of patch application. 2. The top module in ACTUAL_DMA_SYSTEM builds exposes the documented dbg_pause_* ports and the pause_a_i / pause_reads_a_i inputs. 3. The natural write-order experiment remains the only place where pause_mode>0 is valid; the existing +natural validation already forces +mode=s. 4. The pause window duration is counted in pre-edge cycles while pause_active is true; pause_active_cycles starts at 0 at trigger and the window ends when pause_active_cycles >= pause_window. 5. The seal condition waits for the second active cycle to allow a late w_fifo_push at the first edge; held is sampled pre-edge. 6. A job done is derived from n_nat_hw_a_done >= 1, which is updated in the same pre-edge sample. 7. No RTL changes are required; the patch only modifies the C++ harness.
